title: Where Do Vision-Language Models Get Left and Right? Position-Code Counterfactuals in Qwen2.5-VL, Qwen3-VL and InternVL3
abstract: arXiv:2611.14060v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A vision-language model may take left-right direction from the orientation of image content within patches, its vision transformer's (ViT) position code, or token positions and order in its language model (LLM). Ablations show the ViT code is necessary; we test sufficiency by mirroring only a position code. In Qwen2.5-VL-7B, Qwen3-VL-4B and InternVL3-2B, mirroring ViT width positions reproduces the flipped-image answer on 84.3-93.2% of CV-Bench left-right questions (Qwen2.5-VL-3B: 87.5%, partly a left fallback). With two options, this also counts disruption; a half-grid shift flips most answers too. With the ViT code intact, LLM-side id and token-order mirrors change few left-right answers in all three series (a weak id test in Qwen2.5-VL). In Qwen2.5-VL-7B the effect sits in the global-attention ViT blocks, mostly the last. On What'sUp, flipping content and token order, not the position code, keeps more on/under than left-right answer

translated_title: 视觉语言模型从哪里获得左右方位？Qwen2.5-VL、Qwen3-VL与InternVL3中的位置编码反事实研究
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型的左右方位判断可能来源于图像块内内容的朝向、视觉Transformer（ViT）的位置编码，或语言模型（LLM）中词元的位置与顺序。消融实验表明ViT位置编码是必要的；我们通过仅镜像位置编码来检验其充分性。在Qwen2.5-VL-7B、Qwen3-VL-4B和InternVL3-2B中，仅镜像ViT宽度方向的位置编码，就能在CV-Bench左右方位问题上以84.3-93.2%的比例复现翻转图像后的答案（Qwen2.5-VL-3B为87.5%，部分表现为“左”的回退偏差）。在二选一的设置下，这也可视为一种干扰；半格位移同样会翻转大多数答案。在ViT位置编码保持不变时，LLM侧的ID镜像和词元顺序镜像在三个模型系列中都只改变很少的左右答案（Qwen2.5-VL中的ID测试较弱）。在Qwen2.5-VL-7B中，该效应存在于全局注意力的ViT块中，且主要集中在最后一个块。在What'sUp数据集上，翻转图像内容和词元顺序（而非位置编码）会更多地改变上下方位的答案，而非左右方位的答案。
tldr: 该研究通过位置编码反事实实验发现，视觉语言模型的左右方位判断主要由ViT位置编码决定——仅镜像ViT宽度位置即可在84-93%的问题上复现翻转图像的效果，而LLM侧的位置信息影响甚微。
en_tdlr: Through position-code counterfactual experiments, this study reveals that vision-language models derive left-right orientation primarily from ViT position codes—mirroring only ViT width positions reproduces flipped-image answers on 84-93% of questions, while LLM-side positional information plays a minimal role.
